review_scope: Independent narrow review of the third-place Z/DM/X direct handoff and first recovery continuation; no hardware actions.
findings: After the existing release dwell, Z alone raises 40 mm relative to the locked final placement target. True Z DONE enables DM prepare. True DM DONE with Z DONE enables X prepare. The same transaction retains one timeout, STOP/ACK and no broadcast.

X goes directly to the first recovery ring locked goal using real encoder origin. The handoff contract alone allows nonzero X; the loaded return and carry rise contracts still require zero. X completion uses the existing zero or normal goal window and no-op cases still poll.

Matching all-axis completion is required before the first recovery handoff latch. Phase 17 waits for fresh held DM at target then proceeds to phase 19 without duplicate phase 18 or an unsafe turn fallback. PC13, timers, 2 mm/1 degree limits and final zero are unchanged.
Local model confirms forward 13 mm and right 5 mm compensation. No live Pi or physical acceptance is asserted.
